\begin{example} \end{example}[Nonnegative curvature operator] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-ii:page-0225 1. ch13:13.2\group Preserved Curvature Conditions

Nonnegative curvature operator is preserved by Ricci flow in every dimension. In dimensions two and three it is equivalent to nonnegative sectional curvature. Positive isotropic curvature is also preserved in every dimension. \end{example}
Proof

\sketch ↗ thm:chow-ii-curvature-operator-preservation The relevant cones are closed, convex, invariant under parallel transport, and invariant under the curvature reaction ODE. The tensor maximum principle preserves them. In dimensions at most three every two-form is decomposable, which gives the stated equivalence.

□
